cohort: First four review IDs in lexical order in CLEF TAR 2017 testing/extracted_data. Titles only were inspected when specifying these strategies.
agent: Single Codex agent, paired sequential decisions, review titles only at baseline. No seed PMIDs, original published strategies, included lists or case-level scores before locking all choices.
decision_instruction: Keep the original query or omit one adjustable block. Use only the topic, original clauses and the production compact comparison. Balance coverage of synonymous descriptions against additional records to screen at depth 500. A partial preview defaults to keeping the original. Lock all choices before retrieval or scoring.
estimands: Primary: within-review difference in known included PMIDs among the first 500 ranked records. Secondary: gained and lost PMIDs separately, candidate records presented (capped), total matched candidates (uncapped), attempted ESearch requests. No independent adjudication of additional candidates.
